payload.title: Upgrade smart podcast shorts and chronological extracts with editorial review and isolated scenes
acceptance: Both shorts modes analyze full source, select specific coherent ideas and independently critique cuts/context before application.
Chronological mode preserves source order; smart shorts permit meaningful rearrangement without fabricated context.
Canonical extraction appends scenes preserving all original scenes, subtitles and full transcript; regression tests cover both modes.
Resumable bounded inference, validation and local production deployment verified.
